docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Subandhu's prose romance of the prince Kandarpaketu and the princess Vāsavadattā, a masterpiece of Sanskrit ornate prose, in Gray's English translation.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Vāsavadattā of Subandhu, translated by Louis Herbert Gray (1875–1955), Columbia University Indo-Iranian Series, 1913, as proofread on English Wikisource by its contributors; the Sanskrit original is of the seventh century. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
